title: Trials season 3: what you need to know
body:
# Trials season 3: what you need to know

**Get moving, Raiders, Season 3 of Trials has now begun!**

Do you believe you have what it takes to become a Cantina Legend?

Could you be the ghost people speak of in hushed tones in Speranza's darkest corners? A daring soul who Snap-hooks straight into danger with a Deadline tucked under one arm, calm as anything? A guardian who shields the vulnerable from the ARC's slow, calculated push forward?

Show it.

# Understanding Trials

Every week brings a new set of tasks designed to help the people of Speranza.

These rotating weekly Trials might ask you to gather medicinal plants, thin out a troublesome surge of a particular ARC unit, or recover valuable data from tech that predates the collapse.

You have to make your progress within one single raid. If you die, you lose not just your gear but all the progress you built up during that raid too.

Extract safely while holding onto your Trial progress and you'll be well rewarded, receiving blueprints, weapons, and gadgets offered as thanks by the people you're helping at home.

You earn challenge rewards by racking up 1000, 2500, and 4000 points within any one Trial. Each threshold is marked with a star, going from one to three, locking in your saved progress.

Reaching three stars on a given Trial unlocks the full set of rewards available for it. Still, there is more to aim for beyond that.

Every week you compete against a pool of 100 other Raiders, all trying to climb to the next rank. Push hard enough to land the top score and you'll rise into the ranks of Raider legend. Don't contribute enough, though, and you'll drop back down among the rookies.

Season 3 wraps up on April 29, at which point you'll receive unique cosmetics tied to whatever rank you finished at.

Finish the season holding at least Rookie II rank to unlock the exclusive Trials Season 3 outfit, The Torque, complete with extra colorways and outfit variants available for those who push on to reach Daredevil and Hotshot.

Season 3 of Trials is yours to shape. Make it a story worth telling.
